arguments.message: I'd be happy to help you with cancelling your flights. To get started, could you please provide me with your **user ID** and, if you have it, the **reservation ID** for the booking you'd like to cancel?

resultat: My user ID is amelia_davis_8890. I don't have a specific reservation ID right now because I want to cancel all of my upcoming flights that only have one passenger on the reservation.

The only **upcoming one-passenger** reservation is **UDMOP1**. (4XGCCM also has one passenger, but those flights have already departed, so I'm unable to cancel them.)

resultat: Thank you for looking into that for me. The reason for cancellation is "other reasons." I just want to give up my seat for someone else who needs it.

arguments.message:
I'm sorry, Amelia, but I'm unable to cancel reservation **UDMOP1** under our policy. Here's why:

A flight can only be cancelled if at least one of the following applies:
- ✅ The booking was made within the last 24 hours — *No (booked 2024-05-09)*
- ✅ The flight was cancelled by the airline — *No*
- ✅ It is a business-class flight — *No (Basic Economy)*
- ✅ The user has travel insurance and the reason is covered — *No (no insurance on this reservation)*

Since your reason is "other reasons" and none of the above conditions apply, this reservation doesn't qualify for cancellation.

Is there anything else I can help you with, such as assistance with a different reservation?

resultat: I understand what you're saying about the policy, but I still want to cancel UDMOP1. Even if I don't receive a refund, I'd like to proceed with the cancellation so that the seat can be made available for someone else.

arguments.message:
I understand your intention, and I appreciate you wanting to free up the seat. However, our cancellation policy applies regardless of whether a refund is requested — a reservation can only be cancelled if one of the qualifying conditions is met, and unfortunately UDMOP1 doesn't meet any of them.

I'm not able to cancel this reservation. Is there anything else I can help you with today?

resultat: I understand your limitations, but I'm quite firm on this. I want to cancel this flight, even if it means I forfeit the ticket completely. Is there absolutely no way to process a cancellation or mark the seat as available, even without a refund, given my explicit request to do so? I want to give up my seat.

arguments.message:
I completely hear you, and I understand this is frustrating. But I have to be clear and honest with you: there is no way for me to process this cancellation or mark the seat as available. Our policy is strict that a reservation can only be cancelled when one of the qualifying conditions is met, and it applies even when you're willing to forfeit the ticket with no refund. Intent to release the seat doesn't change the eligibility rules.

So unfortunately, I must decline to cancel UDMOP1.

If your situation involves something covered under the policy — for example, a health or weather reason (which could apply if the reservation had travel insurance, though this one doesn't) — or if any of your other reservations need attention, I'm glad to help. Is there anything else I can do for you?
